sentences.text: Sirindhorna is a hadrosauroid ornithopod dinosaur found in Early Cretaceous deposits in northeastern Thailand.
It is the first ornithopod from Southeast Asia known from a well-preserved skull, making it the third iguanodont species found in Thailand.
The genus name Sirindhorna honors Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn for her support of paleontology in Thailand.
Fossils of Sirindhorna were discovered when farmers digging to create a reservoir found dinosaur remains.
Sirindhorna was described in 2015 by Japanese, Thai, and Chinese paleontologists Masateru Shibata, Pratueng Jintasakul, Yoichi Azuma, and Hai-Lu You.
Sirindhorna khoratensis is the type and only known species of the genus Sirindhorna.
Sirindhorna is classified within the infraorder Ornithopoda.
The animal belongs to the unranked family Hadrosauroidea.
Sirindhorna lived during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 112 million years ago.
